pageCache.text:
STARTING PRIMARY SCHOOL IN SEPTEMBER 2027
Children born between 1 September 2022 and 31 August 2023 are due to start the first year of primary school (reception class) in September 2027.
We will hold two opportunities to tour the school, view our Reception classrooms and meet staff:
Wednesday 4th November 2026 9.00am to 10.00am
Tuesday 10th November 2026 4.00pm to 5.00pm
HEADTEACHER'S WELCOME MESSAGE
Welcome to West Acton Primary School
As Headteacher of West Acton for the past eight years, I am incredibly proud to lead such a vibrant and caring school community.
Whether you are a current parent, a new family joining us, a potential Governor, or a prospective member of staff, I hope you find our website and social media pages informative and reflective of all that makes West Acton special.
At West Acton, we celebrate the rich diversity of our community here in London. Our pupils, families and staff come from a wide range of backgrounds, and we believe this diversity makes our school stronger. We are committed to providing a safe, inclusive and nurturing environment where every child feels valued, respected and supported to achieve their best.
We are proud to be recognised as a Microsoft Showcase School and a Centre of Excellence for Inclusion, demonstrating our commitment to innovation, digital learning and the highest standards of teaching and leadership. Our school is judged Good by Ofsted and we offer a broad and ambitious curriculum that balances academic excellence with real-world learning. Through our school vision and values, we ensure pupils develop the skills and confidence they need to thrive in an ever-changing world.
Our dedicated team of teachers and support staff inspire creativity, critical thinking and a lifelong love of learning in every child. Inclusivity lies at the heart of all we do.
We work in close partnership with parents, carers and the wider community to provide a holistic educational experience for our pupils. I look forward to working with you all and continuing to make West Acton Primary School a place where every child can flourish.
Miss Karen KondoHeadteacherJuly 2026
Please email the school office admin@west-acton.ealing.sch.uk with attendance, messages and enquiries

pageCache.pageTitle: Vision and Values | West Acton Primary School
pageCache.text:
VISION AND VALUES
West Acton Primary School, a welcoming community, growing and learning together
At West Acton Primary School, we are a dynamic and inclusive community of lifelong learners. We nurture every child to reach their full potential through an engaging, forward-thinking curriculum and a culture that builds courage, consideration and collaboration. As an aspirational community, our staff, pupils and families grow together—developing digital and emotional intelligence, a strong sense of wellbeing and environmental awareness—ready to make a positive impact on their communities and the wider world.
At West Acton Primary School our core values for our children to have are :
COURAGE, CONSIDERATION and COLLABORATION
We believe in limitless aspirations.We foster an environment wherechildren have the courage to try. Weencourage endeavour, perseverance,resilience and ambition. We inspire aculture of opportunity, curiosity andcreativity. We support children tobecome independent whilst nurturingtheir wellbeing.
We believe in kindness, equality andfairness. We embrace the diversity inour school and value the differencesthat enrich our community. We arewelcoming, open and inclusive,supporting individuals from allbackgrounds and starting points. Wedeliver an inspiring curriculum in asafe and enabling environment.
We believe we are stronger together.We communicate respectfully andwork towards the best possibleoutcomes for all our learners. Weprovide high quality teaching, learningand support. OUr children developunderstanding, empathy andtolerance by belonging to West Actonand the wider world.
We also embed the British Values at West Acton Primary School
At West Acton Primary school we have a strong set of whole school values that we teach and model explicitly to our children. We believe that the fundamental British Values form part of our school values and are taught through our broad and balanced curriculum we provide to all our children. Here are some examples of how we teach British Values as part of the curriculum:
Respect and Tolerance
